bureau: Credit Registry Information System (Banco Central de Timor-Leste)
note: The Banco Central de Timor-Leste's page on its Credit Registry Information System (Instruction 3/2009): a borrower's credit data stays in the registry no less than five years from the credit's full repayment, written as five years. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Banco Central de Timor-Leste, Credit Registry Information System (CRIS)
sources.said: All credit data of borrower will retain in the CRIS for no less than five years from the date of the full repayment of credit.
